articles.title: 3 injured in lithium-ion battery fire at Toronto community housing building
articles.summary: Toronto Fire is investigating another incident involving lithium‑ion batteries following a two-alarm apartment fire downtown that injured three people. Firefighters were called to a fourth-floor unit of Toronto Community Housing building on George Street near Dundas Street East just before 6 a.m. on Wednesday. articles.summary: A man was rushed to hospital with serious injuries after being struck by a vehicle in downtown Toronto early Wednesday morning. articles.title: Bradford vows Bloor Street W. bike lanes are 'coming out' if he's mayor
articles.summary: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising the removal of bike lanes on a west-end street should he win the city’s top job.

articles.title: Toronto police seek public's help in search for missing 63-year-old woman
articles.summary: Police are seeking the public's help in their search for a missing 63-year-old woman, identified as Ann Marie, who was last seen in North York Saturday.

articles.title: 'Everyone is chipping in to make this happen': Toronto charity building micro-shelter village in Scarborough
articles.summary: Tiny Tiny Homes, a Toronto charity that builds mobile and emergency shelters to those experiencing homelessness, is building a micro-shelter village in Scarborough that will provide transitional housing to 10 people by the end of this year.

articles.title: Environment Canada's updated tornado, severe thunderstorm warning system aims to target specific areas
articles.summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada has updated its warning system for tornadoes and severe thunderstorms to allow for more precise warnings about severe weather.
